description: FeedBoss connects your assistant to your LinkedIn content workspace. It drafts posts in your saved voice grounded in your own knowledge base, scores a draft against a reader-reaction quality check before anything is published, saves drafts you can edit, and schedules approved drafts to publish to LinkedIn at a time you confirm each time. It also reports analytics, weekly posting-consistency streaks, and a refreshed wall of high-performing posts for inspiration.

defaultPrompt: Draft a LinkedIn post in my voice about a lesson I learned at work this week.
Score my draft with a reader-reaction check and tell me what to fix before I publish.
Show me popular LinkedIn posts in my industry so I can see what is landing right now.
